critical_issues.msg: Tenant ID is hardcoded to 1 — breaks multi-tenancy entirely for any user whose tenant is not ID 1.
critical_issues.suggestion: Replace the hardcoded `1` with the actual authenticated tenant ID from auth context (e.g., `useAuth()` or a tenant store), passed through the route or a context provider.

critical_issues.msg: useTasks(1, '') fetches all tasks ignoring page/search params, while filtered server data (page, statusFilter) is fetched separately but only used for pagination metadata — pagination info will be incorrect when total > 20.
critical_issues.suggestion: Pass all active filters (statusFilter, priorityFilter, assigneeFilter, createdAfter, createdBefore) to the server via useTasks so the server handles pagination correctly. Remove the allData fetch or use it only when no filters are active.

critical_issues.msg: SettingsIcon is used in JSX (systemItems) but imported as Settings — this will cause a runtime ReferenceError unless Settings is re-exported as SettingsIcon elsewhere.
critical_issues.suggestion: Change import to: `Settings as SettingsIcon` so the alias matches the usage in systemItems.

critical_issues.msg: ApiEnvelope<T> generic is defined but never used — all query functions use Record<string, unknown>, losing compile-time type safety on API responses.
critical_issues.suggestion: Replace ApiEnvelope<Record<string, unknown>> with ApiEnvelope<ActualType> for each query, e.g., ApiEnvelope<Customer>, ApiEnvelope<Task>. Extract shared type aliases for recurring response shapes.

critical_issues.msg: No mutation has an onError handler — API failures result in silent, unhandled errors with no user feedback.
critical_issues.suggestion: Add onError: () => { /* show toast */ } to every useMutation call, or provide a shared error handler.

suggestions.msg: Implementation plan for task router and Kanban enhancements; no code to review.
Coding conventions skill file; well-structured reference for project patterns.
Standard Next.js frontend package manifest; all dependencies are appropriate and pinned.
TaskModal onSubmit has no error handling — if create.mutateAsync rejects, the modal stays open silently and the user gets no feedback.
suggestions.suggestion: Wrap in try/await and call quickAdd.close() only on success; surface the error via toast or setError state on failure.

suggestions.msg: filteredAndSorted() is not memoized — called 4 times per render (lines 60, 83, 124, 143) recalculating the same filtered+sorted array on every render.
suggestions.suggestion: Wrap in useMemo: `const displayed = useMemo(() => filteredAndSorted(), [items, priorityFilter, assigneeFilter, createdAfter, createdBefore, sortKey, sortDir])` and remove the standalone `displayed` variable.

suggestions.msg: useUsers(1, 100) is called for the assignee dropdown but ignores the search parameter — a tenant with many users will have an unfiltered 100-user payload.
suggestions.suggestion: Add a search input for assignees or paginate with a search term if user list is large.

suggestions.msg: SortIconStatic is defined but never called in this file — the static ↕ character is rendered directly in JSX instead.
suggestions.suggestion: Remove the unused SortIconStatic function.

suggestions.msg: filteredAndSorted() / useMemo recalculates on every render — called multiple times per render cycle for tasksByStatus, statusCounts, and countByStatus.
suggestions.suggestion: Memoize the derived values: tasksByStatus and statusCounts already use useMemo but the returned functions (countByStatus, displayed) are recomputed inline; ensure the render-time calls are derived from memoized values.

suggestions.msg: handleDragEnd calls update.mutateAsync without disabling the UI — a second drag-drop during the in-flight request will overwrite the first update with a stale task position.
suggestions.suggestion: Track a `isDragging` boolean state; disable drop targets or show a loading indicator while update.isPending is true.

suggestions.msg: ReactMarkdown renders task.description as HTML — if descriptions are user-supplied, this is an XSS vector despite react-markdown's default HTML stripping (plugins can re-enable raw HTML).
suggestions.suggestion: Pass a remarkPlugins array that explicitly disables dangerouslySetInnerHTML, or use a sanitizer (e.g., DOMPurify) on the rendered output.

suggestions.msg: useOpportunities(1, 100) fetches the first 100 opportunities without a search term — unnecessary data transfer if the list is large.
suggestions.suggestion: Add a search field for opportunities or pass a search term.

suggestions.msg: ReactMarkdown renders task.description as HTML — same XSS consideration as in tasks/page.tsx.
suggestions.suggestion: Use a sanitizer like DOMPurify on the description before passing to ReactMarkdown, or restrict remarkPlugins to prevent raw HTML injection.

suggestions.msg: Customer search input is rendered inside SelectContent (Radix UI) — Radix portals SelectContent on each open, which can cause excessive re-renders or state loss with large customer lists.
suggestions.suggestion: Lift the customer search into a separate combobox pattern or a dedicated popover outside the Select to avoid Radix rendering lifecycle issues.

suggestions.msg: Effect that syncs initialStatus into form.status has task as a dependency but task never changes (only one effect run on mount) — fragile if task prop reference changes.
suggestions.suggestion: Use initialStatus directly in the form state initializer or add a comment explaining the one-time sync intent, or guard with task === undefined.

suggestions.msg: useNotifications(1, true) passes read=true to fetch read notifications, but the sidebar badge is titled 'unreadCount' and is meant to show unread notifications.
suggestions.suggestion: Change to useNotifications(1, false) if unread notifications should appear as the badge count, or verify the API contract for the read parameter.

suggestions.msg: Shield and Upload are imported but not used in crmItems or systemItems.
suggestions.suggestion: Remove unused imports: Shield, Upload.

suggestions.msg: Keyword search encodes the input but other string query params (status, type, unreadOnly) are set via URLSearchParams.set which handles encoding — consistent approach should be applied throughout.
suggestions.suggestion: Ensure all string query parameters go through URLSearchParams.set() (not template literal interpolation) for consistent and safe encoding, as already done for tickets, tasks, activities, and notifications.

suggestions.msg: useActivity uses a hardcoded query key ['activity', id] instead of the centralized qk helper, breaking query key consistency.
suggestions.suggestion: Add activity: (id: number) => ['activity', id] to the qk object and use qk.activity(id) in useActivity.

suggestions.msg: useCompleteTask passes null as the request body for a POST, which may not match the API's expected Content-Type.
suggestions.suggestion: Pass an empty object {} or { id } instead of null, or verify the API accepts a null body for /tasks/${id}/complete.

suggestions.msg: vi.mock for crypto-js is module-level and not reset in beforeEach — if the crypto-js mock state or implementation changes in a future test, it could bleed into other test runs.
suggestions.suggestion: Ensure beforeEach or afterEach explicitly resets or verifies mock state, or isolate tests that depend on specific mock behavior.

suggestions.msg: Tests only cover setAuth, clearAuth, and isAuthenticated — clearAuth also relies on the mock and is not tested independently of setAuth.
suggestions.suggestion: Add a test for clearAuth without a prior setAuth call to verify it is idempotent and handles the null state correctly.

suggestions.msg: open accepts initialStatus as optional (?) but also assigns a default ='pending', making the ? redundant — TypeScript will treat it as optional string anyway.
suggestions.suggestion: Remove the ?: void union and write open: (initialStatus?: string) => void, or simplify to open: (initialStatus = 'pending') => void if callers never pass undefined explicitly.

suggestions.msg: Clean aggregation router that re-exports all feature routers with a clear __all__ list; no issues found.

test_delete_task and test_delete_task_not_found omit the tenant_id_web fixture parameter that all other methods in TestTaskEndpoints carry — a minor inconsistency with no functional impact since auth is handled via the api_client fixture override (rule 20).
suggestions.suggestion: Add tenant_id_web: int to both method signatures to match the class convention.

suggestions.msg: load_dotenv is called at module import time, which can override environment variables set by the test runner or CI pipeline with values from a static .env file (rule 71, 78).
suggestions.suggestion: Remove the load_dotenv call entirely, or guard it behind a check such as 'if "DATABASE_URL" not in os.environ: load_dotenv(...)'

suggestions.msg: self._is_sequence is set in __init__ but never read anywhere in the class — it is dead code (rule 17).
suggestions.suggestion: Remove the _is_sequence instance variable and the isinstance check that computes it.

suggestions.msg: task_handler checks 'insert into tasks' without an early return, and falls through to the 'from tasks where id' guard which would not match INSERT — but the guard ordering is non-obvious and fragile (rule 15).
suggestions.suggestion: Add an explicit 'return MockResult(...)' inside the 'insert into tasks' block and a final bare 'return None' after all guards, to make control flow unambiguous.

suggestions.msg: client_with_service creates a single mock_service instance shared across every test method via a lambda closure — when one test assigns svc.create_task = AsyncMock(...) it mutates the shared object, risking state bleed between tests if execution order changes (rule 65, 63).
suggestions.suggestion: Make client_with_service a factory (accept no arguments, create fresh mocks inside) so each test gets an independently constructed mock_service.

suggestions.msg: test_delete_task omits tenant_id_web from the signature, while every other test method in the class includes it — inconsistent with the established pattern (rule 20).
suggestions.suggestion: Add tenant_id_web: int to the method signature for consistency: async def test_delete_task(self, api_client: AsyncClient, tenant_id_web: int).

suggestions.msg: test_delete_task_not_found omits tenant_id_web from the signature for the same reason as test_delete_task — inconsistent with the class pattern (rule 20).
suggestions.suggestion: Add tenant_id_web: int to the method signature for consistency.
